column1: # The values data_tamer 1.0.4 recorded into recorded_1.0.4.mcap, as the recorder set them:
# topic, log time in ns, flattened name, value. Integers are decimal (a char is its
# byte, a bool 0 or 1); a float is "f:" and the 16 hex digits of its IEEE 754 binary64
# bits (a float32 widened exactly). The name "!undecodable" marks a message with an
# enabled field of the opaque type given as value: decoders reject it.
